title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Schedule of Cancellation and Refund Terms
content:
# Schedule of cancellation and refund terms (Wayfare Pass)

This schedule of the Wayfare Pass (rider membership) terms lists, plan by plan, the figures that govern ending a membership and refunding its fees.

| Plan | Full refund window (calendar days) | Pro rata refund of an annual fee | Pro rata unit | Credit earned in the period deducted from a pro rata refund | Smallest pro rata refund paid (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | 2 | no | none | no | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 2 | no | none | no | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 30 | yes | unused whole months | yes | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 2 | no | none | no | 0.00 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | 30 | yes | unused whole months | yes | 5.00 |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | 30 | yes | unused whole months | yes | 5.00 |

| Plan | Member may end the membership at once | Wayfare refunds anything on a card partner membership |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | yes | no |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | yes | no |

## Meaning of each term

1. **Full refund window**: a fee charge is refunded in full when the member cancels within this many calendar days of the charge date and no benefit was used since that charge, in days.
2. **Pro rata refund of an annual fee**: whether an annual fee not refundable in full is refunded pro rata for unused whole months on immediate cancellation.
3. **Pro rata unit**: the unit of pro rata refunds, which is whole calendar months of the period not yet begun on the cancellation date.
4. **Credit deducted**: whether Pass ride credit earned in the current period is deducted from a pro rata refund.
5. **Smallest pro rata refund paid**: a pro rata refund below this amount is not paid, in USD; 0.00 where proration is not offered.
6. **Ending at once**: whether the member may end the membership at once instead of at period end.
7. **Card partner memberships**: whether Wayfare refunds anything on a membership taken out through a card partner offer.

## Reading notes

- The 30-day window and the pro rata terms go together: Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual and Wayfare Pass All Access Annual. The monthly plans carry a 2-day window and no pro rata refund.
- Hypothetically, a pro rata amount worked out at 4.80 on Wayfare Pass Plus Annual is below 5.00 and is not paid; one worked out at 5.00 is paid.
